title: O Lord, We Give Our Heart To Thee
firstLine: O lord, we give our hearts to thee,

lines: O lord, we give our hearts to thee,
To do thy will we humbly seek
Upon the first day of the week.
Lord, consecrate this bread we break
Thy body offered on the tree
As we by faith Thy body take,
And eat communing now with Thee.
Bless Thou this cup, O precious vine,
Thy blood to wash our sins away.
Lord, wilt Thou grace this feast divine,
And drink anew with us today.
O, Lord, that we might all discern
By faith Thy death to ever see,
And speak to all of Thy return,
In our remembrance, Lord, of Thee.
